description: What a delivered web UI must actually demonstrate. Every item here is observed in a rendered page; none of it is a claim about taste.

required_states.evidence: a status region is present while the catalog request is in flight
an empty cart says so in words rather than showing an empty table
a failed catalog request produces a visible, readable message with a next action

motion.evidence: computed animation and transition durations collapse under the reduced-motion media query

manual_review_required: keyboard walkthrough of each primary journey
screen-reader pass on the checkout flow

assets.policy: Every image, icon and font must have a recorded source and licence. A competitor's logo or an unlicensed asset is not used.

native_targets.rule: A responsive web page is never delivered as a native application. A native target is observed on its own platform.
